purpose: measure the two ciphertext-ciphertext matmuls of a real attention head under CKKS (audit gap 1, second half)
packing: naive: one ciphertext per row, one ct-ct dot per output element. Deliberately not the efficient construction; an upper bound and a correctness baseline.
weights: RANDOM INIT (no local checkpoint) -- numerical fidelity and level consumption only, not accuracy
excluded: row normalisation (Goldschmidt, 13 levels) measured separately in encrypted_primitives.json
SCOPE_CORRECTION_2026_09_09: COMPONENT-WISE, NOT A CHAINED CIRCUIT. This measurement decrypts between stages and re-encrypts at full modulus. The reported level counts are a SUM of three independent measurements (QK^T 1, activation 2, attn.V 1), not four levels consumed continuously, and the reported error does NOT accumulate across stages because each decryption resets the noise. Do not describe this as end-to-end encrypted attention. A continuously encrypted head - decrypting only after attn.V - is not implemented.
